text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of 3-month blocks in which the detector flags a battery, against the battery's power divided by the noise unit (the robust spread of the series' half-hour changes). Band: 95% Clopper-Pearson interval. Dashed line: the 5% false-alarm level. Rung 1 simulated batteries follow the estimator's own dispatch; the other simulated families and the real batteries do not. GSP1's false alarms lift the lowest bins of the top panel.'
text.tspan: Share of 3-month blocks in which the detector flags a battery, against the battery's power divided by the noise
unit (the robust spread of the series' half-hour changes).
Band: 95% Clopper-Pearson interval. Dashed line: the 5% false-alarm level. Rung 1 simulated batteries follow the
estimator's own dispatch; the other simulated families and the real batteries do not. GSP1's false alarms lift the
lowest bins of the top panel.
